title: explore_exit
description: Score one exit family and its parameters on the frozen migrate entry, exploration-pool fast-box data only (tools/exploration_exits.py). See docs/contracts/job-templates.md.

trigger.description: Entry trigger event. Only the pump.fun bonding-curve migration trigger is supported.

family.description: Exit family (tools/exploration_exits.py build_specs()): a fixed take-profit/stop-loss pair, a trailing stop off the running high, a time cap on the tp50/sl30 pair, or a partial take followed by a trailing stop on the remainder.

tp_pct.description: Take-profit target, percent gain from entry. Used by tp_sl_grid and time_cap (time_cap is fixed at 50 in the existing tool, but the knob is exposed here for a future runner).

sl_pct.description: Stop-loss, percent loss from entry. Used by tp_sl_grid and time_cap (time_cap is fixed at 30 in the existing tool, but the knob is exposed here for a future runner).

trail_pct.description: Trailing-stop distance off the running high, percent. Used by trailing_stop.

activation_pct.description: Arm the trailing stop only after this much gain from entry; null arms it immediately. Used by trailing_stop.

take_pct.description: Gain, percent, at which half the position is sold. Used by partial_ladder.

trail_rem_pct.description: Trailing-stop distance, percent, applied to the remaining half after the partial take. Used by partial_ladder.

cap_minutes.description: Time cap on the whole exit: force a close at this many minutes after entry if nothing else fired. All families use this; time_cap sweeps it (2/5/10/30/60 in the existing tool).

size_sol.description: Position size in SOL per entry. The frozen migrate-direct execution this template scores today is 0.5 SOL.

priority_fee_tier.description: Priority-fee tier for slot+1 landing. The frozen execution uses the p75 tier (0.0005 SOL/side, ARTIFACTS/lab/fee-audit-2026-09-27.md); p50/p90 are declared for future runners, not wired yet.

mcap_band.description: Optional market-cap band filter in USD. Omit or set null for no band filter.

min.description: Minimum market cap in USD, inclusive.

max.description: Maximum market cap in USD, exclusive.

days.description: Exploration-pool UTC days to read (docs/HOLDOUT_LEDGER.md), or "all" for the full 3-day fast-box exploration pool tools/exploration_exits.py already reads (2026-09-19 through 2026-09-21).
